PLAN "Couch-to-5K EIA-Safe Build"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary endurance:
    name "Complete a 5K in 12 weeks with controlled intensity and proper warmups"

PHASES
  PHASE "Base Adaptation" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 30m "Run-Walk Intro A":
        warmup:
          walking 10m
        main straight_sets:
          running 6x1 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          walking 6x1 rpe 3 rest 0 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 30m "Run-Walk Intro B":
        warmup:
          walking 10m
        main straight_sets:
          running 8x1 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          walking 8x1 rpe 3 rest 0 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5m
      DAY Saturday training 30m "Run-Walk Intro C":
        warmup:
          walking 10m
        main straight_sets:
          running 10x1 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          walking 10x1 rpe 3 rest 0 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5m
    WEEK 2:
      DAY Monday training 32m "Run-Walk Build A":
        warmup:
          walking 10m
        main straight_sets:
          running 5x2 rpe 5 rest 90 seconds
          walking 5x1 rpe 3 rest 0 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 32m "Run-Walk Build B":
        warmup:
          walking 10m
        main straight_sets:
          running 6x2 rpe 5 rest 90 seconds
          walking 6x1 rpe 3 rest 0 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5m
      DAY Saturday training 34m "Run-Walk Build C":
        warmup:
          walking 10m
        main straight_sets:
          running 4x3 rpe 5 rest 120 seconds
          walking 4x1 rpe 3 rest 0 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 6m
    WEEK 3:
      DAY Monday training 34m "Run-Walk Progress A":
        warmup:
          walking 10m
        main straight_sets:
          running 5x3 rpe 5 rest 120 seconds
          walking 5x1 rpe 3 rest 0 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 36m "Run-Walk Progress B":
        warmup:
          walking 10m
        main straight_sets:
          running 4x4 rpe 5 rest 120 seconds
          walking 4x90 rpe 3 rest 0 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 6m
      DAY Saturday training 38m "Run-Walk Progress C":
        warmup:
          walking 12m
        main straight_sets:
          running 3x5 rpe 5 rest 150 seconds
          walking 3x2 rpe 3 rest 0 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 6m
    WEEK 4:
      DAY Monday training 38m "Continuous Intro A":
        warmup:
          walking 12m
        main straight_sets:
          running 3x6 rpe 5 rest 150 seconds
          walking 3x90 rpe 3 rest 0 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 40m "Continuous Intro B":
        warmup:
          walking 12m
        main straight_sets:
          running 2x8 rpe 5 rest 180 seconds
          walking 2x3 rpe 3 rest 0 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5m
      DAY Saturday training 42m "Continuous Intro C":
        warmup:
          walking 12m
        main straight_sets:
          running 2x10 rpe 5 rest 180 seconds
          walking 2x2 rpe 3 rest 0 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 6m
  PHASE "Continuous Running Build" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 5:
      DAY Monday training 40m "Easy Continuous A":
        warmup:
          walking 12m
        main straight_sets:
          running 1x12 rpe 5 rest 0 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 8m

  PHASE "5K Specific Prep" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 9:
      DAY Monday training 52m "Aerobic Tempo Intro":

          running 1x20 rpe 5 rest 0 seconds
          running 1x8 rpe 6 rest 0 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 12m
      DAY Wednesday training 48m "Easy Run + Strides":
        warmup:

        cooldown:

      DAY Saturday training 56m "Long Easy Run":

    WEEK 10:

    WEEK 11:

        warmup:
